stability.acceptance_basis: Prespecified relative estimate/prediction spread; independent seeds, regularization and omission of first control where available
limitations: Omitting a control is a stress test, not a recommendation to remove a confounder
Stable predictions can coexist with unidentified channel effects
No prior-sensitivity certification; defaults and effective priors are recorded

warnings: No automatic causal or investment certification; missing evidence remains inconclusive

limitations: Conditional moving-block residual bootstrap; constrained null effects may under-cover
DGP includes a train-window scaling rule; effects are interpreted only under this generator
Intervals cover conditional effect contrasts, not individual observed outcomes
Failures remain in attempted denominators; coverage denominator counts available intervals
This study evaluates constrained Ridge; native parameterizations need their own matched-estimand study
Coverage MCSE is a binomial plug-in estimate; consult Wilson intervals especially when estimated coverage is zero or one
